overview.description: Groo The Game is a commercial card game based on Groo the Wanderer where players compete to build the largest town.

history.origins: Published by Archangel Studios in 1997, Groo The Game adapts the comic property into a proprietary card game of town building and disruptive effects.
timeline: Documented card-play form: Groo The Game is described as a distinct game with its own rules.

rules.objective: Construct the largest or highest-scoring town before the game ends.
rules.gameplay: Players play town and effect cards, build up their own settlement, and use Groo-related events to interfere with opponents plans.

strategy.basic: Do not overbuild without defence; a visible leading town attracts the strongest disruptive cards.
strategy.intermediate: Track the cards, suits, or resources that control the next legal plays, and avoid giving opponents a simple route to their scoring condition.
strategy.advanced: Use memory and tempo to force opponents into inefficient plays while preserving cards or resources that complete your own plan.
